mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'school') AS "schools", coalesce(sum(capacity) FILTER (WHERE category = 'school'), 0) AS "schoolCapacity", coalesce(sum(students) FILTER (WHERE category = 'school'), 0) AS "students", coalesce(sum(staff) FILTER (WHERE category = 'school'), 0) AS "schoolStaff", round(sum(students) FILTER (WHERE category = 'school' AND capacity > 0 AND students IS NOT NULL) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(capacity) FILTER (WHERE category = 'school' AND capacity > 0 AND students IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS "seatUtilization", count(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'medical') AS "medical", coalesce(sum(capacity) FILTER (WHERE category = 'medical'), 0) AS "beds", count(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'medical' AND subtype ILIKE '%hospital%') AS "hospitals", count(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'pharmacy') AS "pharmacies", count(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'mosque') AS "mosques", coalesce(sum(capacity) FILTER (WHERE category = 'mosque'), 0) AS "worshippers", count(DISTINCT park_id) FILTER (WHERE category = 'park') AS "parks", round(coalesce(sum(area_sqm) FILTER (WHERE category = 'park'), 0) / 10000.0, 1) AS "parkAreaHa" FROM theme.ast_facility x WHERE true

SELECT coalesce(nullif(x.subtype, ''), 'Unknown') AS "k", count(*) AS "n", coalesce(sum(x.capacity), 0) AS "capacity" FROM theme.ast_facility x WHERE x.category = #{category} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT x.category AS "category", x.source_id AS "id", coalesce(x.name_en, x.name_ar) AS "name", x.name_ar AS "nameAr", x.subtype AS "subtype", x.sub_category AS "subCategory", x.capacity AS "capacity", x.students AS "students", x.staff AS "staff", x.is_public AS "isPublic", round(x.area_sqm, 0) AS "areaSqm", x.plot_key AS "plotKey", ST_X(x.centroid) AS "cx", ST_Y(x.centroid) AS "cy", x.attrs::text AS "attrs" FROM theme.ast_facility x WHERE x.category = #{category} ORDER BY coalesce(x.capacity, x.area_sqm, 0) DESC, 3 LIMIT #{limit}

WITH p AS (SELECT theme.inner_point(geom) AS g FROM theme.sp_plot WHERE plot_key = #{plot}), f AS (SELECT x.category AS cat, x.source_id AS id, coalesce(x.name_en, x.name_ar) AS name, x.subtype AS sub, x.centroid AS g2 FROM theme.ast_facility x, p WHERE x.centroid && ST_Expand(p.g, 0.012) AND x.plot_key IS DISTINCT FROM #{plot} UNION ALL (SELECT DISTINCT ON (coalesce(b.gtfs_id, b.id::text)) 'bus', coalesce(b.gtfs_id, b.id::text), b.name, b.code, b.geom FROM theme.ops_bus_stop b, p WHERE b.geom && ST_Expand(p.g, 0.012) ORDER BY coalesce(b.gtfs_id, b.id::text), ST_Distance(b.geom::geography, p.g::geography))) SELECT f.cat AS "category", f.id AS "id", f.name AS "name", f.sub AS "subtype", round(ST_X(f.g2)::numeric, 6) AS "cx", round(ST_Y(f.g2)::numeric, 6) AS "cy", round(ST_Distance(f.g2::geography, p.g::geography)::numeric) AS "dist" FROM f, p WHERE ST_DWithin(f.g2::geography, p.g::geography, #{radius}) ORDER BY 7
SELECT round(ST_X(theme.inner_point(geom))::numeric, 6) AS "cx", round(ST_Y(theme.inner_point(geom))::numeric, 6) AS "cy" FROM theme.sp_plot WHERE plot_key = #{plot}
